fields.note: AIAA S-120A and SAWE RP 7 tables are paywalled and were not opened. The allowances are NASA GSFC IDC Table VI-1 (NTRS 20120013284), adapted from AIAA S-120-2006 Table 1. My map from maturity to its TRL rows is estimated to TRL 0-2, calculated to TRL 3-5 and measured to TRL 8. Different tables shift the numbers; no plausible table brings the concept-stage allowance below the 2.8-9.9% that the bills tolerate.
